about: Prices buyers outside Nigeria pay, and what it costs to get each commodity to them from each zone state. EU: the declared value of the EU's imports from Nigeria (Eurostat), landed at the EU border with sea freight and insurance paid - not a price at Lagos port - published about 10 weeks after the month. West Africa: market prices in neighbouring countries (FAO; national statistics offices, FEWS NET, Afrique Verte), 1-3 months old. Freight within Nigeria is an estimate. 'room' is what is left of the price abroad after buying in the state and trucking to the port or border: it must still cover export charges, sea freight or border costs, and margin.

fx.source: Central Bank of Nigeria official euro rate; 655.957 CFA francs = 1 euro (fixed).

freight.basis: Estimate: one rate for all roads; distance = straight line x 1.3. Excludes loading, levies and border or port charges.

sources.Eurostat: Eurostat Comext DS-045409, EU imports from Nigeria by product, monthly. ec.europa.eu/eurostat - free to reuse with attribution.
sources.FAO: FAO GIEWS Food Price Monitoring and Analysis tool (fpma.fao.org), republishing the national statistics offices of Niger, Benin, Togo, Chad and Cameroon, FEWS NET and Afrique Verte.
sources.CBN: Central Bank of Nigeria official euro rate; 655.957 CFA francs = 1 euro (fixed).
